name: Rob the place
desc:
SHIPYARD MAP UPDATE!
New map, new machine for rebirth in Hobo Hideout, new GOD rarity rats, and more!

Times are rough, and you need to put food on the table for you and your family. You decide the best way to do this is to become a full-time thief. However, the guards give you a real tough time so you need to watch your back at all times.

- 🐀 Unlock new rats that give you a speed boost.
- ♻️ Rebirth to unlock special areas and new features.
- ❤️ Try not to die.

🛠️ Join the group to receive exclusive benefits.

Please leave a like on the game to show your support! 👍
Inspired by Rob a Convenience Store Simulator

Tags: Rob, Steal, Thief, Thief Simulator, Hard, Store, Escape
